area51-have-doughnut.name: area51-have-doughnut.pdf
area51-have-doughnut.description: Declassified 1969 Foreign Technology Division/DIA tactical evaluation report (Project HAVE DOUGHNUT, Vol. II, FTD-CR-20-13-69-INT) comparing a captured Soviet MiG-21F-13 (FISHBED) with USAF and USN fighters through F-4, F-105, F-106, F-8, and A-6 engagement tests, mission summaries, and tactical recommendations.

area51-skylab-memo.name: area51-skylab-memo.pdf
area51-skylab-memo.description: A 1974 CIA memo to the Director of Central Intelligence, on a SKYLAB mission that photographed an excluded location and the interagency split over releasing that imagery to the Sioux Falls repository, with the DoD elements opposing release and NASA and State favoring it.

area51-u2-oxcart-history.name: area51-u2-oxcart-history.pdf
area51-u2-oxcart-history.description: Declassified CIA history excerpt on the founding and operation of the U-2 reconnaissance program (Project AQUATONE), covering its 1954–1956 establishment, Air Force partnership, pilot recruitment and training, security, cover story, and related intelligence coordination.

cuba-bay-of-pigs-ig-report.name: cuba-bay-of-pigs-ig-report.pdf
cuba-bay-of-pigs-ig-report.description: CIA Inspector General Lyman Kirkpatrick's October 1961 survey of the Bay of Pigs (Cuban) operation, a 1962 DCI memorandum package with its annexes, and related distribution and review memos from November 1961 to February 1962.

metadata.title: Bay of Pigs Inspector General Report

cuba-castro-plots-report.name: cuba-castro-plots-report.pdf
cuba-castro-plots-report.description: This document is the CIA Inspector General's 1967 report on plots to assassinate Fidel Castro, prepared for DCI Richard Helms by J.S. Earman with E.K. Greer and S.D. Breckinridge, released under the JFK Assassination Records Act, with the Preface covering its destruction-and-custody history and the body covering the schemes (poison cigars, the Gambling Syndicate/Roselli-Giancana operation, and the AMLASH/Rolando Cubela plot) and the Pearson leak inquiry.

metadata.title: Report on Plots to Assassinate Castro

cuba-khrushchev-letters.name: cuba-khrushchev-letters.pdf
cuba-khrushchev-letters.description: Khrushchev-Kennedy correspondence during the Cuban Missile Crisis (Oct 23 – Dec 19, 1962) from JFK Library President's Office File Box 115, covering the US naval quarantine, Soviet missile removal terms, IL-28 bombers, UN verification, and a December 1962 proposal for nuclear test ban inspections.

cuba-mongoose-cuba-project.name: cuba-mongoose-cuba-project.pdf
cuba-mongoose-cuba-project.description: Declassified 1998 JFK Records Act identification form for a 1962 TOP SECRET, 24-page memorandum on Operation Mongoose and "The Cuba Project" (dated 01/18/62), reviewed by Brig. Gen. E. G. Lansdale, covering U.S. plans to spur an internal Cuban revolt and the intelligence, political, and military tasks due February 1962.

cuba-operation-northwoods.name: cuba-operation-northwoods.pdf
cuba-operation-northwoods.description: Declassified 1962 Joint Chiefs of Staff documents on Operation Northwoods and the Cuba Project (Operation MONGOOSE), covering proposed pretexts for U.S. military intervention in Cuba, including staged Guantanamo incidents, the "Remember the Maine" scenario, and the March 9, 1962 Caribbean Survey Group report.

deepsea-azorian-history.name: deepsea-azorian-history.pdf
deepsea-azorian-history.description: Declassified-release notice (SECRET NOFORN) on the CIA's Hughes Glomar Explorer/AZORIAN program, with its acknowledged sponsorship, contractors, and 1975 media fallout, plus the broader AZORIAN operation document covering the 1974 Soviet submarine recovery, its cost, the Summa break-in and leak, and the 40 Committee and review-panel history, and the 1972–1978 SEGRE project overview of ship trials, the 1978 recovery and plutonium contamination, and mission end.

deepsea-matador-meeting.name: deepsea-matador-meeting.pdf
deepsea-matador-meeting.description: March 19, 1975 White House Cabinet Room memorandum of conversation (SECRET/NODIS, declassified) in which President Ford, Schlesinger, Colby, Buchen, Marsh, Rumsfeld, and Scowcroft discuss the successful "Matador" operation, whether to confirm it publicly, and Soviet reaction, with the accompanying archival folder record for Box 10 of the NSA Memoranda of Conversations collection.

deepsea-thresher-inquiry.name: deepsea-thresher-inquiry.pdf
deepsea-thresher-inquiry.description: Volume I of the 1963 U.S. Navy Court of Inquiry record on the loss of USS Thresher (SS(N)-593) on 10 April 1963, covering the front matter and exhibit indexes, convening directives, findings, opinions, recommendations, and sworn testimony from the New London and Portsmouth hearings.

fbi-einstein.name: fbi-einstein.pdf
fbi-einstein.description: This OCR-garbled FBI file excerpt (Part 1 of 9, BUFILE 61-7099) on Albert Einstein covers his proposed exclusion from the United States under the Alien Exclusion and Deportation laws, his alleged anarchist and communist affiliations, and his War Resisters International ties, including a 1932 Lyon address and a fund he authorized.

fbi-elvis.name: fbi-elvis.pdf
fbi-elvis.description: This FBI case file on Elvis Presley covers his 1970 visit to FBI headquarters, a 1959 threat letter from Canton, Ohio, mid-1950s Hoover correspondence on censorship, and 1968 Louisville hoax and harassing telephone calls.

fbi-hemingway.name: fbi-hemingway.pdf
fbi-hemingway.description: An FBI file compilation (1942–1974) on Ernest Hemingway's unofficial intelligence work for Ambassador Spruille Braden's embassy in Havana, his Spanish Loyalist and leftist affiliations, and related figures such as Gustavo Duran, Jacob Canter, and Edward Scott.

fbi-hitler.name: fbi-hitler.pdf
fbi-hitler.description: A scanned, OCR-garbled FBI file compilation (1943–1949) of unverified tips and Hoover correspondence claiming Adolf Hitler survived the war in Argentina, Brazil, or elsewhere, alongside the forensic review of his captured marriage certificate and political testament.

fbi-lennon.name: fbi-lennon.pdf
fbi-lennon.description: A partially OCR-garbled 1972 FBI file compilation on John Lennon and Yoko Ono's New York deportation case, covering alleged funding of the EYSIC group's plans to disrupt the Republican National Convention, activities of Rennie Davis and Jerry Rubin, PCPJ and May Day planning, and redacted FOIPA deletion sheets.

fbi-monroe.name: fbi-monroe.pdf
fbi-monroe.description: An FBI file compilation (1956–1973) on playwright Arthur Miller and his circle, centered on his HUAC contempt citation and his marriage to Marilyn Monroe, with related material on Monroe's Mexico visits, Frederick Vanderbilt Field, and the American Colony in Mexico Communist Group.

fbi-steve-jobs.name: fbi-steve-jobs.pdf
fbi-steve-jobs.description: The FBI's 1991 background check on Steve Jobs, run when he was considered for the President's Export Council, plus a 1985 bomb threat case against Apple. Interviewees praised his drive, while some said he would 'twist the truth and distort reality' to reach his goals.

metadata.title: Steve Jobs's FBI File
metadata.tree: Flash found no layout structure; the tree was written from the page text.

gadgets-acoustic-kitty.name: gadgets-acoustic-kitty.pdf
gadgets-acoustic-kitty.description: A memorandum (MQRI Document 21897) reviewing a cat-training program that proved impractical for the agency's specialized needs, followed by a passage crediting the personnel who guided the work.

gadgets-project-1794.name: gadgets-project-1794.pdf
gadgets-project-1794.description: Avro Aircraft's June 1956 final report on Project 1794/704, a VTOL jet using propulsive jets for stabilization, covering design progress, wind tunnel and intake tests, labour and cost summaries, production aspects, and proposed follow-on programs, under USAF Contract AF 33(600)-30161.

gadgets-simple-sabotage.name: gadgets-simple-sabotage.pdf
gadgets-simple-sabotage.description: The OSS Simple Sabotage Field Manual No. 3 (Strategic Services, 1944), a preface and introduction covering the purpose, effects, motivation, and tactics of simple sabotage by ordinary citizens using everyday items.

jfk-countering-criticism.name: jfk-countering-criticism.pdf
jfk-countering-criticism.description: A declassified 1967 CIA compilation (approved for release 2025/12/29) that surveys and critiques books by Warren Commission critics such as Epstein, Lane, and Weisberg, and recommends tactics for rebutting them.

jfk-kgb-lbj-memo.name: jfk-kgb-lbj-memo.pdf
jfk-kgb-lbj-memo.description: This document is a declassified-era FBI/Justice Department collection on Soviet and Communist Party reactions to President Kennedy's assassination, covering the Warren Commission, Oswald's Soviet history, Yuri Nosenko, and Progressive Labor, Pravda, and Izvestia commentary, dated 1963–1966.

metadata.title: Hoover Memo on the KGB and LBJ

jfk-schlesinger-cia-memo.name: jfk-schlesinger-cia-memo.pdf
jfk-schlesinger-cia-memo.description: A 1961 memo to President Kennedy, from Schlesinger Jr. (Sorensen Papers, NARA JFK release), on reorganizing CIA control, covering its autonomy from State, covert operations policy, and a proposed doctrine for clandestine activity in an open society.

mind-ig-report-1963.name: mind-ig-report-1963.pdf
mind-ig-report-1963.description: Declassified 1950s CIA inspection report and related memoranda on the MKULTRA/TSD program, covering its 1953 DCI authorization, funding and audit controls, covert human testing of chemical and biological behavior-altering agents, and recommendations for stricter oversight.

mind-midnight-climax.name: mind-midnight-climax.pdf
mind-midnight-climax.description: This 1956 CIA memorandum from MKULTRA Subproject 42, signed by Sidney Gottlieb, sets up a covert drugging facility using a safehouse and payments to Mr. ___, with cash-only disbursements to operatives, no receipts, and per-operation reporting to the Chief, TSS/Chemical Division.

mind-mkultra-hearing.name: mind-mkultra-hearing.pdf
mind-mkultra-hearing.description: Senate Select Committee hearing document on CIA Project MKULTRA (1977), covering the program's history, Subproject 35 research wing funding, Frank Olson's death, drug research, and related DCI correspondence.

mind-project-bluebird.name: mind-project-bluebird.pdf
mind-project-bluebird.description: A declassified 1950s CIA file on Project BLUEBIRD, covering its proposal for polygraph, drug, and hypnosis interrogation teams, their budgets (about $65,515 to $93,015), security handling rules, and related Project ARTICHOKE and OSI collection efforts, with much of the OCR text garbled.

mind-subproject-119.name: mind-subproject-119.pdf
mind-subproject-119.description: A scanned, OCR-garbled 1957–1963 grant file for a literature survey and annotated bibliography on recording, analyzing, and remotely activating human bioelectric signals, containing budgets, a financial statement for a Bioelectronics directory project, and correspondence.

mind-subproject-35.name: mind-subproject-35.pdf
mind-subproject-35.description: A heavily OCR-garbled collection of declassified CIA memos (1953–1977) on MKULTRA Subproject 35, covering the proposed $125,000 to $375,000 Agency contribution to a university research wing for covert biological and chemical research, with matching Public Law 221 funds.

nuclear-goldsboro-revisited.name: nuclear-goldsboro-revisited.pdf
nuclear-goldsboro-revisited.description: A 1960s-era redacted document quoting Dr. Ralph Lapp on the 1961 B-52 bomb drop near Goldsboro, North Carolina, and critiquing the safety of the Mk 39 bomb and its ready-safe switch, with Greensboro and Palomares references.

nuclear-project-a119.name: nuclear-project-a119.pdf
nuclear-project-a119.description: A 1959 Air Force Special Weapons Center report (TR-59-39, Vol. I) by L. Reiffel titled "A Study of Lunar Research Flights," examining scientific and military motivations, political effects, and technical areas for nuclear detonations on or near the Moon, including optical, seismic, radiation, surface, plasma, and organic matter studies.

nuclear-sac-target-study.name: nuclear-sac-target-study.pdf
nuclear-sac-target-study.description: Declassified 1959 Strategic Air Command "Atomic Weapons Requirements for 1959" document set (TOP SECRET RESTRICTED DATA, Doc ID 32003765), covering SAC target systems, Air Power Battle targeting, weapon allocation, damage criteria, and stockpile requirements, with Authority 27356 target lists and catalogs.

presidents-pdb-bin-ladin.name: presidents-pdb-bin-ladin.pdf
presidents-pdb-bin-ladin.description: This document is a two-page fragmentary intelligence summary on Bin Laden's intent to strike the United States, covering 1997–1998 plots and embassy bombings, followed by an August 6, 2001 "For the President Only" note on suspicious FBI activity and about 70 full field investigations.

metadata.title: Bin Ladin Determined To Strike in US

presidents-pentagon-papers-tonkin.name: presidents-pentagon-papers-tonkin.pdf
presidents-pentagon-papers-tonkin.description: The Pentagon Papers-style declassified history, Vol. IV.C "Evolution of the War: Direct Action, The Johnson Commitments, 1964-1968," covering U.S. military pressures against North Vietnam from July to October 1964, including the Gulf of Tonkin incidents, the Tonkin Gulf Resolution, NSAM 314, and related Laos operations and deliberations.

presidents-watergate-road-map.name: presidents-watergate-road-map.pdf
presidents-watergate-road-map.description: The House Judiciary Committee transmittal of the June 5, 1972 grand jury report on the Watergate indictments and Nixon's possible impeachment, with its evidence index covering the E. Howard Hunt $120,000 demand, John Dean's testimony, and the President's public statements through 1973.

psychic-air-evaluation.name: psychic-air-evaluation.pdf
psychic-air-evaluation.description: The AIR (Mumford, Rose & Goslin, 1995) evaluation of the CIA-era remote viewing program: front matter, an executive summary finding significant lab hits but no operational intelligence value, and chapter-level outlines covering background, the evaluation plan, the Utts and Hyman expert reviews, conclusions, and appendices including the StarGate tasking evaluation.

psychic-crv-manual.name: psychic-crv-manual.pdf
psychic-crv-manual.description: February 1985 CIA working paper on Coordinate Remote Viewing (CRV) training, covering its six sequential stages, ideograms, a sample Stage I–VI session identifying the Mayan Temple at Tulum, future stages, conclusions, and a glossary of terms.

psychic-dozier-padua.name: psychic-dozier-padua.pdf
psychic-dozier-padua.description: A partially declassified, OCR-garbled 1981–1982 CIA document (CIA-RDP96-00788R001700370004-1) describing a moated building site in Italy near Verona and Padua, with city and site data sections and a summary table of cuing-method response totals.

metadata.title: Grill Flame and the Dozier Kidnapping

psychic-gateway-process.name: psychic-gateway-process.pdf
psychic-gateway-process.description: A 1983 report by Army Lt. Col. Wayne McDonnell assessing the Monroe Institute's Gateway Experience, a course that uses audio tapes to synchronize the brain's hemispheres (Hemi-Sync). It tries to explain the course's claims of out-of-body states and perception beyond time and space in terms of physics, drawing on Itzhak Bentov's models.

metadata.title: Gateway Process Assessment
metadata.tree: Flash found no layout structure; the tree was written from the page text.

psychic-kress-review.name: psychic-kress-review.pdf
psychic-kress-review.description: This document is a declassified CIA Studies in Intelligence piece by Dr. Kenneth A. Kress (Winter 1977) reviewing the Agency's sponsorship of parapsychology research, including ESP and psychokinesis, remote viewing projects with subjects like Pat Price, and the program's inconclusive results and termination.

psychic-mars-1984.name: psychic-mars-1984.pdf
psychic-mars-1984.description: A declassified 1984 CIA remote-viewing session transcript (CIA-RDP96-00788R001900760001-9) in which a subject, given geographic coordinates and an envelope, describes Mars-like landscapes, obelisks, aqueducts, and ancient tall figures sheltering from storms.

psychic-uri-geller-sri.name: psychic-uri-geller-sri.pdf
psychic-uri-geller-sri.description: The CIA-declassified 1973 SRI report on Uri Geller's apparent remote-viewing and telepathy experiments (August 4–11), covering shielded-room drawing tests, computer-graphics and memory-storage tests, and long-distance telepathy trials, with a mostly unreadable OCR-residue section.

satellites-corona-story.name: satellites-corona-story.pdf
satellites-corona-story.description: A declassified November 1987 history of the CORONA reconnaissance satellite program by Frederic Oder, James Fitzpatrick, and Paul Worthman, covering its origins in WS-117L, Sputnik-era acceleration, the Discoverer cover, contractor selection, NRO formation, and imagery achievements, with appendices on intelligence organizations and representative imagery.

satellites-hexagon-recovery-memo.name: satellites-hexagon-recovery-memo.pdf
satellites-hexagon-recovery-memo.description: A 1972 HEXAGON memo and attachments detailing the July 1971 loss, October 1971 location, and 1972 Trieste II deep-sea recovery attempts for reconnaissance recovery vehicle RV-3 (lost at about 16,000 ft after a parachute failure), including the partial film recovery and lessons learned.

metadata.title: Deep Sea Recovery of HEXAGON RV 1201-3

space-lunik-kidnapping.name: space-lunik-kidnapping.pdf
space-lunik-kidnapping.description: The Winter 1967 *Studies in Intelligence* front matter (Vol. 11, No. 1, declassified 2019) sets out the journal's editorial policy and Editorial Board, and "The Kidnaping of the Lunik" describes a covert CIA operation that borrowed a Soviet Lunik probe stage from a foreign trade exhibition, photographed and sampled it at a salvage yard, and reassembled it to recover factory markings and production details.

space-mol-dorian.name: space-mol-dorian.pdf
space-mol-dorian.description: NRO Center for the Study of National Reconnaissance's 2015 compendium *The Dorian Files Revealed*, edited by James D. Outzen, which presents Carl Berger's history of the cancelled Manned Orbiting Laboratory (MOL) program with its declassified Dorian documents index.

space-moon-disaster.name: space-moon-disaster.pdf
space-moon-disaster.description: This is the 1969 "Nixon Moon disaster" contingency speech memo, drafted by William Safire for H. R. Haldeman, covering the Apollo 11 crew (Armstrong and Aldrin) and its closing instructions for the President's call to the widows and a burial-at-sea-style service.

space-project-horizon.name: space-project-horizon.pdf
space-project-horizon.description: Project HORIZON Volume I (1959 U.S. Army study) proposing a manned military lunar outpost, covering its justification, technical design, transportation, Army technical services support, legal and political implications, and conclusions.

ufo-hottel-memo.name: ufo-hottel-memo.pdf
ufo-hottel-memo.description: FBI FOIA cover sheet for subject Guy Hottel (dated 1950), followed by a heavily garbled OCR page describing an alleged recovered craft with three-celled structure, ~3-foot humanoid figures in metallic cloth, and three bodies in bandage-like wrapping.

ufo-odni-preliminary-assessment.name: ufo-odni-preliminary-assessment.pdf
ufo-odni-preliminary-assessment.description: Preliminary ODNI assessment (June 2021) of unidentified aerial phenomena (UAP) reporting from 2004–2021, covering the threat to flight safety and national security, the likely multiple explanations for incidents, and the DoD UAP Task Force's analytic and collection needs under Senate Report 116-233.

ufo-roswell-case-closed.name: ufo-roswell-case-closed.pdf
ufo-roswell-case-closed.description: The Roswell Report: Case Closed by James McAndrew (U.S. Air Force, 1997), a front-matter-to-appendix document that refutes the Roswell "alien crash" and hospital-body claims by tying them to Project Mogul, high-altitude balloon anthropomorphic dummy drops (Project High Dive and Excelsior), and real Walker AFB accidents such as the 1956 KC-97 crash and 1959 balloon mishap.
